title: Free UNI claim A League title
description: Free UNI - Griffin 77-57 Free UNI outgunned Griffin in the fourth game of the championship series to conquer A League trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Free UNI. Griffin managed to win third quarter 20-18. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Worth to mention a great performance of American guard Kevon Voyles (190-2000, college: Marshall) who helped to win the game recording 25 points, 5 assists and 4 steals. Guard Levan Qvartskhava (194-2002) contributed with 14 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. American forward Daniel Ransom (198, college: OKBU, agency: Interperformances) replied with a double-double by scoring 21 points and 10 rebounds (made all of his eight free throws) and forward Vakhtang Gogberashvili (202-2002) added 12 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists in the effort for Griffin. title: Rustavi sweep Griffin to conquer A League title
description: Griffin - Rustavi 100-102 Rustavi swept Griffin in the championship series and clinched Superleague promotion. The guests trailed by 14 points after first quarter, but they rallied back and won the game by 2 points. Rustavi made 25-of-32 free shots (78.1 percent) during the game. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 23 assists. 28 personal fouls committed by Griffin helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. It was a good game for American point guard Malik Tidwell (180-2001, college: Georgia South) who led his team to a victory with 24 points and 8 assists (on 9-of-10 shooting from the field). Forward Guga Patashuri (201-1998) contributed with 23 points for the winners. Four Rustavi players scored in double figures. title: VSA celebrate A League title
description: Sokhumi - VSA 67-78 VSA clinched A League title and therefore punched Superleague ticket for the next season. They prevailed against Sokhumi 3-1 in the championship series. The guests trailed by 4 points at the halftime before their 43-28 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. VSA outrebounded Sokhumi 41-30 including 31 on the defensive glass. 25 personal fouls committed by Sokhumi helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American guard Kameron Warrens (196, college: Mary) fired a double-double by scoring 18 points and 12 rebounds for the winners. The other American import point guard Jermaine Head (186-1997, college: WILMU) chipped in 21 points and 6 assists. Mamuka Bazuashvili (198-1996) produced 12 points and 8 rebounds and American guard PJ Byrd (185-1999, college: Southern) added 17 points and 4 assists respectively for lost side. Sokhumi's…

title: A League Round 4 of Finals. Orbi claim title; earn promotion
description: Iverioni - Orbi 81-99 Orbi earned A League title and therefore gained Superleague promotion. They upset Iverioni in Game 4 of the title series to capture the trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Orbi. Iverioni managed to win third quarter 28-24. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Orbi had a 33-21 advantage in offensive rebounds. It was a great shooting night for Orbi especially from behind the arc, where they had solid 52.4 percentage. The game was dominated by American players. Guard Demarcus Addie (188, college: S.Wesleyan) fired a double-double by scoring 23 points, 10 rebounds and 4 assists for the winners. Point guard Kenny Cooper (183, college: Tennessee St.) chipped in a double-double by scoring 20 points, 10 rebounds and 6 assists. title: Kavkasia earn A League title, Superleague promotion
description: Astrali - Kavkasia 76-77 Kavkasia celebrated A League title. They nipped Astrali in Game 4 of the Finals to earn the trophy and subsequently the promotion to Superleague. The guests trailed by 13 points after first quarter, but they rallied back and won the game by 1 point. Strangely Astrali outrebounded Kavkasia 52-40 including a 39-28 advantage in defensive rebounds. American players dominated the game. Worth to mention a great performance of center Riley Hayes (203-1998, college: Catholic) who helped to win the game recording 21 points and 9 rebounds. Guard Jordan Grant (190-1996, college: W.Connecticut) contributed with a triple-double by scoring 10 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists for the winners. title: Mega celebrate A League title
description: Kavkasia - Mega 86-96 Mega clinched A League title. They beat Kavkasia on the road today to complete the sweep of the championship series. Mega looked well-organized offensively handing out 23 assists comparing to just 10 passes made by Kavkasia's players. The best player for the winners was American guard Aston Francis (185-97, college: Wheaton, IL) who scored 23 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists. Point guard Irakli Mikeladze (180-94) chipped in 27 points and 4 assists. At the other side the best for losing team was American point guard Elliott Cole (180-94, college: Charleston) who recorded 27 points and 4 assists and guard Giorgi Rukhadze (183-0) added 15 points and 8 rebounds respectively. Four Kavkasia players scored in double figures.
